verdict.rationale: Zep documents full-user erasure via a single API call (delete User deletes all Threads and thread artifacts, explicitly for Right To Be Forgotten/privacy compliance), and also supports fine-grained deletion at the edge/node level (deleting a node cascades to connected edges, and an edge can be deleted directly via client.graph.edge.delete). This covers single-memory, per-entity (node/edge), and full-user erasure as described in the story. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification that deletion is complete/irreversible in practice, and no explicit documentation of deleting a single episode/message-level memory distinct from edges/nodes.
